title: Empty Matrix
description: 🫙 Tests the edge case where the matrix contains no elements.

title: Single Element Matrix
description: 🎯 Verifies that a 1x1 matrix remains completely unchanged after rotation.

title: 2x2 Even Matrix
description: 🔲 Tests the simplest multi-element rotation for an even-dimension matrix.

title: 3x3 Odd Matrix
description: 🎲 Tests an odd-dimension matrix where the center element must pivot exactly in place.

title: 4x4 Complex Matrix
description: 🧩 Validates multiple inner and outer layers of rotation using a larger grid with non-sequential values.

title: 5x5 Matrix (Multiple Rings)
description: 🍩 Tests a larger odd-dimension matrix requiring two full outer ring rotations plus a center pivot.

title: Negative and Zero Values
description: 🥶 Ensures the logic holds up regardless of integer sign or zero values.

title: Duplicate Values
description: 👯‍♀️ Verifies rotation when elements are not strictly unique, preventing value-swapping bugs.

title: Non-Sequential Values
description: 🔀 Ensures the rotation doesn't secretly rely on numbers being in an expected ascending order.
